entities.summary: "Tomorrow Can Wait" is an electro house song performed by French DJ David Guetta, American singer Chris Willis and German DJ Tocadisco from Guetta's third studio album, Pop Life. The song was released as the album's fifth single on 7 July 2008. A music video was first released onto YouTube on 15 August 2008 at a total length of three minutes and forty-seven seconds.
